notes: A dead end for the cart requirement, and worth recording as one because the specification is genuinely good and a normal English search surfaces it repeatedly. The page describes exactly the product is hunting: 256 MB, 21 forwarded ports, a native /64, explicitly IPv6-native, aimed at a VPN or tunnel. But it publishes no price and has no order link - the page source contains no cart.php target at all - and the five WHMCS product groups that do exist are shared hosting, reseller, KVM VPS, dedicated and colocation. So there is no way to buy this from the page that describes it, and the price is a dash rather than a guess. The vendor's own terms are the most hostile read: no SLA, no refund under any circumstances, a HK$500 dispute charge, up to 128 VPS per physical server, and an explicit warning that 'there may be no VPS services provided at all'. The verdict is dead as an offer, not as a company: the product page sells nothing, and the billing area might still sell it behind a login; what would settle it is a ticket to sales asking for the NAT-VPS price and order URL, which needs an account and was out of scope.
